course.title: Mathematics - II
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Examine the four points (0,1,2), (3,0,1), (4,3,6) and (2,3,2) are coplaner or not. If they are non-coplaner, then find the volume of the tetrahedron, whose vertices are those four points.
